incline-db-press.name: Incline dumbbell press
incline-db-press.desc: An angled press that focuses on the upper chest. Dumbbells allow a free path and make both arms work equally.
cues: Set the bench to 20–30°: higher shifts the work to the shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled together and pressed into the bench, feet flat on the floor.
Lower the dumbbells under control to chest level and don't clank them at the top.
mistakes: Bench angle too steep, turning it into a shoulder press.
Elbows flared straight out, shoulders rolling forward.
incline-db-press.safety: Pick a weight you can safely lower onto your thighs after the set. Shoulder pain: shorten the range or reduce the weight.

flat-press.name: Machine chest press or flat dumbbell press
flat-press.desc: A compound press for the middle chest. Choose the version where you control the range better: machine or dumbbells.
cues: Keep your shoulder blades pulled together and steady for the whole set.
Elbows at about 45–60° from your body, not straight out to the sides.
Press smoothly without lifting your hips off the bench.
mistakes: Shoulders creeping up to the ears at the top.
Bouncing the weight off the chest instead of lowering it under control.
flat-press.safety: On a machine, set the seat so the handles are level with the middle of your chest. With dumbbells, don't go to failure without a spotter.

high-to-low-cable-fly.name: High-to-low cable fly
high-to-low-cable-fly.desc: An isolation move for the lower chest. The handles travel down and towards each other.
cues: Step forward, lean slightly, keep a small, fixed bend in the elbows.
Sweep the handles down in an arc and bring them together in front of your lower chest.
Return slowly and feel the stretch in your chest.
mistakes: Turning it into a press by bending and straightening the elbows.
Too much weight pulling the shoulders back and forth.
high-to-low-cable-fly.safety: Don't let your arms travel too far back in the stretch, especially if your shoulders are sensitive.

rope-pushdown.name: Rope triceps pushdown
rope-pushdown.desc: Triceps isolation, especially the lateral and medial heads.
cues: Elbows stay pinned to your sides; only the forearms move.
At the bottom, spread the rope ends apart and hold for a second.
Keep your torso still, no swinging.
mistakes: Elbows drifting forward and back, bringing in the shoulders.
Leaning the whole body over the weight.
rope-pushdown.safety: If your elbow hurts, reduce the weight and don't snap the arm straight.

overhead-cable-extension.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
overhead-cable-extension.desc: Extending the arms overhead works the triceps in a stretched position, with a focus on the long head.
cues: Stand facing away from the cable, elbows pointing forward and staying in place.
Don't arch your lower back: lightly brace your abs.
Work in a comfortable range, no jerk at the bottom.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out to the sides.
Arching the lower back to lift more.
overhead-cable-extension.safety: If your shoulder feels uncomfortable, shorten the range or switch to the rope pushdown.

single-arm-pushdown.name: Single-arm cable pushdown
single-arm-pushdown.desc: A one-arm pushdown on the high cable. Helps even out strength between arms and control each side.
cues: Upper arm still, elbow by your side.
Straighten the arm fully and return slowly.
mistakes: Torso twisting along with the arm.
Rushing the reps without control.
single-arm-pushdown.safety: Optional exercise: if your triceps are already fried from pressing, skip it.

lat-pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat-pulldown.desc: A vertical pull for the lats. A good stand-in for pull-ups with adjustable weight.
cues: Start by pulling your shoulder blades down, then drive the elbows down.
Pull the bar to your upper chest with a slight lean back.
At the top, straighten your arms fully but keep the shoulders engaged.
mistakes: Pulling behind the neck.
Swinging the torso to move the weight.
lat-pulldown.safety: Lock your thighs under the pads. Don't let the bar yank your arms up at the top.

seated-cable-row.name: Seated cable row
seated-cable-row.desc: A seated row to the stomach for the mid-back, rhomboids and lats.
cues: Long spine, torso almost still.
Pull the handle to your lower stomach, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end, without shrugging.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth.
Rounding the back at the start of each rep.
seated-cable-row.safety: Keep the knees slightly bent. If your lower back feels strained, reduce the weight and keep the torso steadier.

chest-supported-db-row.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
chest-supported-db-row.desc: A row lying chest-down on an incline bench. The support takes load off the lower back; works the upper back and rear delts.
cues: Lie chest-down on a bench set to 30–45°, arms hanging freely.
Drive the elbows back and slightly out, no jerking.
No bench? A chest-supported row machine works too.
mistakes: Chest lifting off the bench on every rep.
Pulling with the arms only, without moving the shoulder blades.
chest-supported-db-row.safety: Pick up and put down the dumbbells carefully, without twisting off the bench.

incline-db-curl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
incline-db-curl.desc: Curls seated on an incline bench: arms behind the body, biceps stretched, focus on the long head.
cues: Back against the bench, shoulders behind your torso.
Don't let the elbows travel forward as you lift.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.
mistakes: Shoulders rolling forward to help lift the weight.
Dropping the dumbbells on the way down.
incline-db-curl.safety: Start light: the stretched position puts more load on the biceps tendon.

preacher-curl.name: Preacher curl or machine curl
preacher-curl.desc: Curls with the upper arm resting on a pad. Removes cheating and focuses on the short head of the biceps.
cues: Keep your upper arm firmly on the pad the whole time.
Don't snap the elbow straight at the bottom.
mistakes: Lifting the upper arm off the pad at the top.
Lowering too fast.
preacher-curl.safety: The bottom position is the most vulnerable for the elbow: lower slowly and never drop the weight.

hammer-curl.name: Hammer curl
hammer-curl.desc: Curls with a neutral grip. Load the brachialis and brachioradialis.
cues: Palms face each other through the whole movement.
No swinging, shoulders stay down.
mistakes: Elbows moving forward.
Swinging the back on the last reps.
hammer-curl.safety: Keep your wrists straight, don't bend them back.

wrist-curl.name: Seated wrist curl
wrist-curl.desc: Isolation for the forearm flexors. Strengthens your grip.
cues: Forearms rest on your thighs or a bench; only the hands move.
Moderate weight, full and smooth range.
mistakes: Forearms lifting off the support.
Too heavy, with a short range.
wrist-curl.safety: If your wrists or elbows feel uncomfortable, reduce the weight or drop the exercise.

reverse-wrist-curl.name: Seated reverse wrist curl
reverse-wrist-curl.desc: Isolation for the forearm extensors. Balances out wrist curls.
cues: Overhand grip, forearms resting on the support.
Slow, no jerking.
mistakes: Jerking instead of a smooth movement.
Using the same weight as for wrist curls: the extensors are much weaker.
reverse-wrist-curl.safety: If your wrists or elbows feel uncomfortable, reduce the weight or drop the exercise.

seated-shoulder-press.name: Seated dumbbell or machine shoulder press
seated-shoulder-press.desc: A compound overhead press for the front and side delts.
cues: Back against the pad, don't arch your lower back.
Don't lower the elbows past a comfortable depth.
Press up and slightly in, without clanking the dumbbells.
mistakes: Strong arch in the lower back.
Taking every set to failure.
seated-shoulder-press.safety: Set the backrest almost upright. Shoulder pain: shorten the range or reduce the weight.

lateral-raise.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cues: Raise to about shoulder height.
Elbows slightly bent and leading the movement.
Torso stays still.
mistakes: Swinging the body to throw the dumbbells up.
Shrugging, so the traps take over.
lateral-raise.safety: A light weight with clean form beats a heavy one. Don't raise above shoulder height if it feels uncomfortable.

reverse-pec-deck.name: Reverse pec deck
reverse-pec-deck.desc: Opening the arms on a machine while facing the pad. Isolation for the rear delts.
cues: Open the arms using the shoulders; don't squeeze the shoulder blades hard.
Neck relaxed, chest against the pad.
mistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades instead of working the rear delts.
Jerking and pulling too far back.
reverse-pec-deck.safety: Adjust the seat height so the handles are at shoulder level.

db-shrug.name: Dumbbell shrug
db-shrug.desc: Raising the shoulders while holding dumbbells. Loads the upper traps.
cues: Shoulders straight up, no rolling.
Short pause at the top, slow on the way down.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders.
Bending the elbows.
db-shrug.safety: Keep your neck neutral; don't push the chin forward.

incline-y-raise.name: Incline Y-raise
incline-y-raise.desc: Raising the arms in a Y shape while lying chest-down on a bench. Strengthens the lower traps and shoulder-blade stabilisers. You can alternate it with cable face pulls.
cues: Very light dumbbells or no weight at all.
Raise the arms in a Y shape, thumbs pointing up.
Don't tense the neck; keep the shoulder blades down.
mistakes: Too heavy, so the movement turns into a jerk.
Shoulders creeping up to the ears.
incline-y-raise.safety: This is about control, not strength: stop if your shoulder hurts.

cable-crunch.name: Kneeling cable crunch
cable-crunch.desc: A kneeling crunch with a rope. Loads the abs with adjustable weight.
cues: Curl your ribcage towards your pelvis; don't pull the rope with your arms.
Hips stay almost still; the movement comes from the upper spine.
mistakes: Bending forward at the hips instead of crunching.
Pulling with the arms.
cable-crunch.safety: Breathe out as you crunch. If your lower back feels strained, reduce the weight and range.

hanging-knee-raise.name: Hanging or supported knee raise
hanging-knee-raise.desc: Raising the knees to the chest while hanging from a bar or supported on a dip station. Works the abs, especially at the end of the movement.
cues: At the top, tuck the pelvis rather than just lifting the knees.
Lower the legs slowly, no swinging.
If it's too hard, start on the dip station.
mistakes: Swinging the whole body.
Lifting the legs with the hip flexors only, without tucking the pelvis.
hanging-knee-raise.safety: Get down from the bar carefully. If your shoulders hurt while hanging, use the dip station.

side-plank.name: Side plank
side-plank.desc: A static hold on one forearm, side-on. Works the obliques and side stability of the torso.
cues: Body in a straight line from head to feet.
Elbow under the shoulder, hips don't sag.
mistakes: Hips dropping or drifting back.
Holding your breath.
side-plank.safety: Stop if your shoulder or lower back hurts. An easier version is with the bottom knee down.

pallof-press.name: Pallof press
pallof-press.desc: Pressing a cable handle away from your chest while standing side-on to the machine. Trains resisting rotation of the torso.
cues: Stand side-on to the cable, feet shoulder-width apart.
Press the handle straight out and hold for 1–2 seconds.
Don't let your torso turn towards the cable.
mistakes: Torso rotating with the cable.
Too much weight, losing control.
pallof-press.safety: You can use a resistance band. Keep the shoulders down and elbows soft.

dead-bug.name: Dead bug
dead-bug.desc: Lying on your back, you lower the opposite arm and leg in turns. Trains the deep core stabilisers.
cues: Lower back pressed into the floor the whole time.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg.
Breathe out as you lower them.
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.
Moving too fast.
dead-bug.safety: If your lower back lifts, shorten the range: don't lower the leg as far.

leg-press.name: Leg press
leg-press.desc: A compound machine exercise for the quads and glutes, with back support.
cues: Feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Lower the platform under control, knees tracking over the toes.
Don't lock the knees at the top.
mistakes: Going so deep that the pelvis tucks under and the lower back lifts.
Knees caving inwards.
leg-press.safety: Hips and lower back stay against the pad the whole time. Use the machine's safety stops.

leg-curl.name: Machine leg curl
leg-curl.desc: Isolation for the hamstrings, lying or seated.
cues: Smooth, no jerking.
You don't need maximum weight; control at the bottom matters more.
mistakes: Hips lifting off the seat.
Dropping the weight on the way down.
leg-curl.safety: Set the pad just above your heels and the machine's pivot level with your knee.

calf-raise.name: Calf raise
calf-raise.desc: Rising onto the toes, standing or on a machine. Works the calves.
cues: Full, comfortable range of motion.
Pause at the top, slow on the way down.
mistakes: Bouncing reps with no pause.
Bending the knees to help.
calf-raise.safety: Without a machine, hold on to something for balance.

barbell-bench-press.name: Barbell bench press
barbell-bench-press.desc: Pressing a barbell up from the chest while lying on a flat bench. Works the chest, front delts and triceps.
cues: Eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
Shoulder blades pulled back and down, keep them there for the whole set.
Lower the bar under control to the lower chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press up and slightly back, toward your shoulders.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Elbows flared straight out to the sides.
Hips lifting off the bench.
barbell-bench-press.safety: Use a rack with safety arms set just below the lowest point, or a spotter. Put collars on the bar. Skip the set if you can't control the movement. Unrack and rerack with straight arms.

incline-barbell-press.name: Incline barbell press
incline-barbell-press.desc: Bench press on an incline bench. Shifts more work to the upper chest and front delts.
cues: Set the bench at about 30°; higher turns it into a shoulder press.
Shoulder blades back, chest up.
Lower the bar to the upper chest, below the collarbones.
Press straight up, wrists stacked over elbows.
mistakes: Bench angle too steep.
Bar drifting toward the face or neck.
Lifting the hips to make the press easier.
incline-barbell-press.safety: Use a rack with safety arms set just below the lowest point, or a spotter. Put collars on the bar. Skip the set if you can't control the movement.

db-fly.name: Dumbbell fly
db-fly.desc: Opening the arms wide with dumbbells while lying on a bench. Stretches and works the chest.
cues: Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows.
Open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells together as if hugging a big tree.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows, turning it into a press.
Going too deep, past a comfortable stretch.
db-fly.safety: Choose a lighter weight than for presses. Shoulder pain means a shorter range or less weight.

pec-deck.name: Pec deck (machine fly)
pec-deck.desc: Bringing the arms together in front of the chest on a machine. A controlled isolation for the chest.
cues: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Keep the elbows soft and the shoulders down.
Squeeze for a moment when the handles meet, then return slowly.
mistakes: Letting the weight pull the arms too far back.
Shrugging the shoulders up.
pec-deck.safety: Adjust the seat and the handle start position before the set so the stretch stays comfortable.

chest-dip.name: Chest dip
chest-dip.desc: Lowering and pushing yourself up on parallel bars with the torso leaning forward. Works the chest and triceps.
cues: Lean forward slightly, elbows travel back and a little out.
Lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows, or as far as is comfortable.
Push up until the arms are straight without locking hard.
mistakes: Dropping fast into the bottom.
Shoulders rolling forward and up toward the ears.
Going deeper than your shoulders allow.
chest-dip.safety: Start with an assisted dip machine or a band if you can't control the bottom. Stop if you feel pain in the front of the shoulder.

push-up.name: Push-up
push-up.desc: Pushing yourself up from the floor with a straight body. Works the chest, triceps and shoulders and trains the core.
cues: Hands a bit wider than the shoulders, under the chest.
Body in one line from head to heels, glutes tight.
Lower the chest close to the floor, then push away.
mistakes: Hips sagging or sticking up.
Elbows flared out at 90°.
Half reps without lowering the chest.
push-up.safety: If full push-ups are too hard, put your hands on a bench or do them from the knees.

incline-push-up.name: Incline push-up
incline-push-up.desc: Push-up with the hands on a bench or a box. An easier version that teaches the same position.
cues: Hands on a stable bench, slightly wider than the shoulders.
Body in one straight line, glutes and abs tight.
Touch the bench with the chest, then push away.
mistakes: Hips sagging.
Head dropping toward the bench before the chest.
incline-push-up.safety: Make sure the bench or box can't slide or tip over.

close-grip-push-up.name: Close-grip push-up
close-grip-push-up.desc: Push-up with the hands close together. Puts more work on the triceps.
cues: Hands under the shoulders or a bit closer.
Elbows travel back along the body, not out to the sides.
Body in one line, push the floor away.
mistakes: Hands so close that the wrists hurt.
Hips sagging.
close-grip-push-up.safety: If your wrists complain, put the hands slightly wider or use push-up handles.

deadlift.name: Deadlift
deadlift.desc: Lifting a barbell from the floor to standing. Works the back of the legs, glutes and the whole back.
cues: Bar over the middle of the foot, shins close to the bar.
Grip just outside the legs, back flat, chest up.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close to the legs all the way up.
Stand tall at the top, don't lean back.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Bar drifting away from the legs.
Jerking the bar off the floor.
deadlift.safety: Learn the movement with a light weight first. Put collars on the bar and lower it under control, don't drop it. Skip the set if you can't keep your back flat.

romanian-deadlift.name: Romanian deadlift
romanian-deadlift.desc: Hip hinge from standing with a barbell: the hips move back, the bar slides down the legs. Works the hamstrings and glutes.
cues: Start standing, knees slightly bent and staying that way.
Push the hips back and slide the bar down the thighs.
Go down until you feel a strong stretch in the back of the thighs, back flat.
Return by driving the hips forward.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower.
Bending the knees more and turning it into a squat.
Bar drifting away from the legs.
romanian-deadlift.safety: Put collars on the bar. Lower only as far as you can keep your back flat. Skip the set if you can't control the movement.

barbell-row.name: Barbell row
barbell-row.desc: Pulling a barbell to the belly while bent over. Works the upper back and lats.
cues: Hinge at the hips, knees slightly bent, back flat.
Grip a bit wider than the shoulders.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs, elbows back.
Lower it under control without moving the torso.
mistakes: Standing up more with every rep.
Jerking the weight with the whole body.
Rounding the back.
barbell-row.safety: Put collars on the bar. Start light: the lower back works hard to hold the position. Skip the set if you can't keep your back flat.

one-arm-db-row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
one-arm-db-row.desc: Pulling a dumbbell to the hip with one arm, the other hand and knee on a bench. Works the lats and upper back.
cues: Hand and knee on the bench, back flat and parallel to the floor.
Pull the dumbbell toward the hip, elbow close to the body.
Lower it all the way down under control.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.
Pulling with the arm only, shrugging the shoulder.
one-arm-db-row.safety: Keep the supporting arm straight and the back flat. Reduce the weight if the lower back rounds.

t-bar-row.name: T-bar row
t-bar-row.desc: Rowing one end of a barbell fixed at the other end, or on a T-bar machine. Works the back.
cues: Hinge at the hips, back flat, knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle toward the chest, elbows back.
Lower under control until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Lifting the torso with every rep.
Rounding the back at the bottom.
t-bar-row.safety: Fix the end of the bar in a landmine or a corner so it can't slide. Put collars on the plates.

pull-up.name: Pull-up
pull-up.desc: Pulling yourself up to a bar with an overhand grip. Works the lats and upper back.
cues: Grip slightly wider than the shoulders, palms facing away.
Start from a hang with the shoulders pulled down.
Pull until the chin is above the bar, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Swinging and kicking the legs.
Half reps without straightening the arms.
Dropping fast to the bottom.
pull-up.safety: If you can't do a full pull-up yet, use an assisted machine, a band or slow lowering only.

chin-up.name: Chin-up
chin-up.desc: Pull-up with an underhand grip. More work for the biceps.
cues: Grip shoulder-width, palms facing you.
Pull the chest toward the bar, elbows down and back.
Lower all the way down under control.
mistakes: Swinging to get up.
Craning the neck toward the bar.
chin-up.safety: Elbow discomfort means a slightly wider grip or the assisted version.

assisted-pull-up.name: Assisted pull-up
assisted-pull-up.desc: Pull-up on a machine with a knee pad that helps you up. Teaches the full movement.
cues: Kneel on the pad, grip the handles above.
Pull the shoulders down first, then the chest up.
Lower slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Bouncing off the pad at the bottom.
Shrugging the shoulders up.
assisted-pull-up.safety: Step on and off the machine carefully: set the help level before getting on the pad.

close-grip-pulldown.name: Close-grip pulldown
close-grip-pulldown.desc: Pulldown with a narrow neutral handle. Works the lats through a long range.
cues: Thighs under the pads, torso leaning back slightly.
Pull the handle to the upper chest, elbows down.
Let the arms straighten fully at the top.
mistakes: Leaning far back and turning it into a row.
Pulling with the arms only.
close-grip-pulldown.safety: Hold the handle until the weight stack is back down, don't let it fly up.

straight-arm-pulldown.name: Straight-arm pulldown
straight-arm-pulldown.desc: Pushing a cable bar down in an arc with straight arms. Isolates the lats.
cues: Stand a step back from the cable, lean forward slightly.
Arms almost straight, pull the bar down to the thighs in an arc.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the lats.
mistakes: Bending the elbows and turning it into a pushdown.
Rocking the torso to move the weight.
straight-arm-pulldown.safety: Keep the weight moderate: this is a control exercise, not a strength one.

inverted-row.name: Inverted row
inverted-row.desc: Pulling the chest to a bar set at waist height, heels on the floor. Works the back.
cues: Body in one straight line from head to heels.
Pull the chest to the bar, elbows back.
Lower until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Hips sagging.
Pulling the chin instead of the chest to the bar.
inverted-row.safety: Make sure the bar is fixed securely in the rack. Bend the knees to make it easier.

machine-row.name: Machine row
machine-row.desc: Seated row on a machine with a chest pad. A stable way to work the back.
cues: Chest against the pad, feet planted.
Pull the handles back, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return until the arms are straight, keep the chest on the pad.
mistakes: Leaning away from the pad to move more weight.
Shrugging the shoulders.
machine-row.safety: Set the seat so the handles are level with the lower chest.

db-pullover.name: Dumbbell pullover
db-pullover.desc: Lowering a dumbbell behind the head and bringing it back over the chest, lying on a bench. Works the lats and chest.
cues: Hold one dumbbell with both hands, arms almost straight.
Lower it behind the head in an arc until you feel a stretch.
Bring it back over the chest.
mistakes: Bending the elbows a lot and turning it into a triceps exercise.
Arching the lower back at the bottom.
db-pullover.safety: Hold the dumbbell securely by the plate. Start light: the end position stretches the shoulders.

back-extension.name: Back extension
back-extension.desc: Lifting the torso on a back extension bench. Works the lower back and glutes.
cues: Pad just below the hip bones, heels under the rollers.
Lower the torso with a flat back.
Rise until the body is in one line, no higher.
mistakes: Overarching at the top.
Swinging with momentum.
back-extension.safety: Start without extra weight. Stop if you feel pain in the lower back.

dead-hang.name: Dead hang
dead-hang.desc: Hanging from a bar with straight arms. Trains grip and the shoulders.
cues: Grip the bar a bit wider than the shoulders.
Hang with straight arms, keep the shoulders slightly active.
Breathe calmly and hold for the planned time.
mistakes: Jumping on and off the bar.
Holding the breath.
dead-hang.safety: Step down onto a box or the floor; don't drop from a height.

back-squat.name: Barbell back squat
back-squat.desc: Squat with a barbell on the upper back. Works the quads and glutes, the whole body holds the position.
cues: Bar on the upper back, not on the neck; grip firm, elbows down.
Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit down between the heels, knees follow the toes, back flat.
Stand up by pushing the floor away, chest and hips rise together.
mistakes: Knees caving in.
Heels lifting off the floor.
Rounding the lower back at the bottom.
back-squat.safety: Squat in a rack with safety arms set just below your lowest point, or with a spotter. Put collars on the bar. Skip the set if you can't control the movement.

front-squat.name: Front squat
front-squat.desc: Squat with the barbell resting on the front of the shoulders. Keeps the torso upright and puts more work on the quads.
cues: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high, fingertips under the bar.
Torso stays as upright as possible.
Sit straight down, knees forward over the toes.
Drive up keeping the elbows high.
mistakes: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward.
Leaning forward and turning it into a good morning.
Gripping the bar too hard and straining the wrists.
front-squat.safety: Squat in a rack with safety arms set just below your lowest point, or with a spotter. Put collars on the bar. Skip the set if you can't control the movement. If the bar slips forward, let it fall onto the safety arms and step back.

goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet-squat.desc: Squat holding a kettlebell or a dumbbell at the chest. A good way to learn the squat.
cues: Hold the weight close to the chest, elbows down.
Sit down between the heels, chest up.
Push the knees out in line with the toes and stand up.
mistakes: Weight drifting away from the chest.
Heels lifting off the floor.
goblet-squat.safety: Choose a weight you can hold securely for the whole set.

db-sumo-squat.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
db-sumo-squat.desc: Wide-stance squat with one dumbbell hanging between the legs. Works the quads, glutes and inner thighs.
cues: Feet wider than the shoulders, toes turned out.
Hold the dumbbell with straight arms, torso upright.
Lower down with the knees following the toes, then stand up.
mistakes: Knees caving in.
Leaning forward and rounding the back.
db-sumo-squat.safety: Use a stance width that feels comfortable in the hips.

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian-split-squat.desc: One-leg squat with the rear foot on a bench. Works the quads and glutes of the front leg.
cues: Rear foot on the bench, front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until the rear knee is close to the floor.
Push through the whole front foot to stand up.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench.
Front knee caving in.
Pushing off with the rear leg.
bulgarian-split-squat.safety: Learn the position without weight first. Keep the bench stable and the floor clear around you.

db-lunge.name: Dumbbell lunge
db-lunge.desc: Step into a lunge and back with dumbbells in the hands. Works the legs and glutes, trains balance.
cues: Long step, both knees bend to about 90°.
Torso upright, weight on the whole front foot.
Push back to the start with the front leg.
mistakes: Front knee caving in.
Steps so short that the front heel lifts.
db-lunge.safety: Do it without weight until you feel steady. Make sure there is room around you.

walking-lunge.name: Walking lunge
walking-lunge.desc: Lunges moving forward step after step. Works the legs and trains balance.
cues: Step forward and lower until the back knee is close to the floor.
Drive up and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep the torso upright and the steps even.
mistakes: Narrow steps, like walking on a line.
Rushing and losing balance.
walking-lunge.safety: You need a clear path. Start without weight.

leg-extension.name: Leg extension
leg-extension.desc: Straightening the knees on a machine. Isolation for the quads.
cues: Align the knee with the machine's pivot.
Straighten the legs smoothly, pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight bang.
mistakes: Kicking the weight up with momentum.
Lifting the hips off the seat.
leg-extension.safety: Set the ankle pad just above the feet. Knee discomfort means a lighter weight or a shorter range.

seated-leg-curl.name: Seated leg curl
seated-leg-curl.desc: Bending the knees against resistance on a seated machine. Isolation for the hamstrings.
cues: Thigh pad snug, knees in line with the pivot.
Pull the heels down and back smoothly.
Return slowly until the legs are almost straight.
mistakes: Jerking the weight.
Sliding forward in the seat.
seated-leg-curl.safety: Adjust the seat and pads before the set so the knees line up with the pivot.

glute-bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute-bridge.desc: Lifting the hips while lying on the back with bent knees. Works the glutes.
cues: Feet flat, heels close to the hips.
Push through the heels and lift the hips until the body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and lower slowly.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.
Pushing through the toes.
glute-bridge.safety: Lie on a mat. If the lower back is uncomfortable, lift the hips a little lower.

barbell-hip-thrust.name: Barbell hip thrust
barbell-hip-thrust.desc: Driving the hips up with a barbell on them, upper back on a bench. A strong exercise for the glutes.
cues: Upper back against the bench edge, bar over the hip crease.
Feet flat, shins vertical at the top.
Drive the hips up until the torso is level, chin tucked.
Lower under control.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Feet too far, so the hamstrings take over.
Bench sliding back.
barbell-hip-thrust.safety: Put a pad on the bar and collars on the plates. Make sure the bench is stable and can't slide. Skip the set if you can't control the movement.

seated-calf-raise.name: Seated calf raise
seated-calf-raise.desc: Raising the heels against a pad on the knees, seated. Works the calves.
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform, pad on the knees.
Rise as high as possible, pause at the top.
Lower slowly to a stretch.
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom.
Short, fast reps.
seated-calf-raise.safety: Release the safety catch only when the pad is firmly on the knees.

step-up.name: Step-up
step-up.desc: Stepping up onto a bench or a box. Works the quads and glutes, trains balance.
cues: Whole foot on the box.
Stand up using the top leg, without pushing off with the bottom one.
Step down under control.
mistakes: Box too high, the knee goes above the hip.
Bouncing off the bottom foot.
step-up.safety: Use a stable box or bench that can't slide. Start without weight.

hip-adduction.name: Hip adduction machine
hip-adduction.desc: Squeezing the legs together against pads on a machine. Works the inner thighs.
cues: Sit back, back against the pad.
Bring the legs together smoothly.
Return slowly to a comfortable opening.
mistakes: Opening wider than is comfortable.
Letting the weight snap the legs open.
hip-adduction.safety: Set the starting width so the stretch stays comfortable.

hip-abduction.name: Hip abduction machine
hip-abduction.desc: Pushing the legs apart against pads on a machine. Works the outer hips and glutes.
cues: Sit back, back against the pad.
Push the knees out smoothly.
Return slowly, don't let the plates touch.
mistakes: Swinging with momentum.
Leaning forward and back.
hip-abduction.safety: Choose a weight you can move smoothly through the whole range.

hack-squat.name: Hack squat machine
hack-squat.desc: Squat on a machine with an angled back pad. Works the quads with a stable back position.
cues: Back and shoulders against the pads, feet in the middle of the platform.
Lower until the thighs are about parallel to the platform.
Push the platform away without locking the knees hard.
mistakes: Heels lifting.
Knees caving in.
hack-squat.safety: Release and set the safety handles carefully before and after the set.

db-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
db-romanian-deadlift.desc: Hip hinge with dumbbells: the hips move back, the dumbbells slide down the legs. Works the hamstrings and glutes.
cues: Knees slightly bent and fixed.
Push the hips back, dumbbells close to the legs.
Return by driving the hips forward.
mistakes: Rounding the back.
Turning it into a squat.
Dumbbells drifting forward.
db-romanian-deadlift.safety: Lower only as far as you can keep your back flat.

single-leg-rdl.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
single-leg-rdl.desc: Hip hinge on one leg, the other leg reaches back. Works the hamstrings and glutes and trains balance.
cues: Standing knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward as the free leg reaches back, hips stay level.
Return to standing under control.
mistakes: Hips twisting open.
Rounding the back.
single-leg-rdl.safety: Start without weight and hold on to something for balance if needed.

wall-sit.name: Wall sit
wall-sit.desc: Holding a sitting position against a wall. Static work for the quads.
cues: Back flat against the wall.
Slide down until the knees are close to 90°, feet under the knees.
Breathe calmly and hold.
mistakes: Knees going far past the toes.
Holding the breath.
wall-sit.safety: Wear shoes with grip so the feet don't slide. Stand up if the knees hurt.

lateral-band-walk.name: Lateral band walk
lateral-band-walk.desc: Side steps in a half squat with a band around the legs. Works the outer hips and glutes.
cues: Band above the knees or around the ankles.
Half squat, feet hip-width.
Step to the side keeping tension on the band.
mistakes: Feet coming together and the band going slack.
Standing up between steps.
lateral-band-walk.safety: Check the band for tears before use.

cable-kickback.name: Cable kickback
cable-kickback.desc: Kicking one leg back with an ankle strap on a low cable. Isolation for the glutes.
cues: Hold the frame, slight forward lean.
Push the leg back without arching the lower back.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Swinging the leg.
Arching the lower back to go higher.
cable-kickback.safety: Fasten the ankle strap firmly. Choose a weight you can move without swinging.

overhead-press.name: Standing barbell overhead press
overhead-press.desc: Pressing a barbell from the shoulders to overhead while standing. Works the shoulders and triceps, the core holds the position.
cues: Bar on the front of the shoulders, grip just outside them.
Glutes and abs tight, ribs down.
Press straight up, moving the head back slightly to let the bar pass.
Finish with the bar over the middle of the foot, arms straight.
mistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press.
Bar travelling forward away from the face.
Pushing with the legs.
overhead-press.safety: Take the bar from a rack at shoulder height and put collars on it. Use safety arms or a spotter for heavy sets. Skip the set if you can't control the movement.

bent-over-lateral-raise.name: Bent-over lateral raise
bent-over-lateral-raise.desc: Raising dumbbells out to the sides while bent forward. Works the rear delts and upper back.
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft.
Raise the arms out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Lower slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Standing up during the set.
Swinging the weight with the torso.
bent-over-lateral-raise.safety: Use light dumbbells: the rear delts are small. Sit on a bench and lean forward if the lower back gets tired.

front-raise.name: Front raise
front-raise.desc: Raising dumbbells or a cable handle in front to shoulder height. Works the front delts.
cues: Arms almost straight, palms down.
Raise to shoulder height, no higher.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the weight up.
Shrugging the shoulders.
front-raise.safety: Light weight is enough: the front delts already work in all presses.

upright-row.name: Upright row
upright-row.desc: Pulling a bar or dumbbells up along the body to chest height. Works the side delts and traps.
cues: Grip about shoulder-width or wider, not narrow.
Lead with the elbows, pull to lower chest height.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Narrow grip with the elbows above the shoulders.
Pulling up to the chin.
Jerking the weight.
upright-row.safety: Start light: some shoulders don't tolerate this exercise. Use a wide grip, pull only to lower chest height and stop at any pinching or pain in the shoulder; lateral raises work the same muscles.

face-pull.name: Face pull
face-pull.desc: Pulling a cable rope toward the face with the elbows high. Works the rear delts and upper back.
cues: Cable at upper chest height or a bit higher, rope grip.
Pull the rope toward the eyes, elbows high and wide.
Pull the ends apart and pause, then return slowly.
mistakes: Pulling to the chest with the elbows low.
Leaning back to move more weight.
face-pull.safety: Keep the weight light and the movement smooth.

arnold-press.name: Arnold press
arnold-press.desc: Seated dumbbell press that starts with the palms facing you and turns them out on the way up. Works the shoulders.
cues: Start with the dumbbells in front of the shoulders, palms toward you.
Turn the palms out as you press up.
Reverse the turn on the way down.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the bench.
Rushing the turn.
arnold-press.safety: Choose a lighter weight than for a regular shoulder press. Shoulder pain means a shorter range.

cable-lateral-raise.name: Cable lateral raise
cable-lateral-raise.desc: Raising one arm out to the side with a low cable. Steady tension for the side delts.
cues: Stand side-on to the cable, handle in the far hand.
Raise the arm out to shoulder height, elbow slightly bent.
Lower slowly to the front of the hip.
mistakes: Leaning away to swing the weight.
Raising the shoulder toward the ear.
cable-lateral-raise.safety: Start light: the cable gives tension at the bottom where dumbbells don't.

band-external-rotation.name: Band external rotation
band-external-rotation.desc: Rotating the forearm outward against a band with the elbow at the side. A light exercise for the back of the shoulder.
cues: Elbow at the side, bent at 90°.
Rotate the forearm outward, keep the elbow in place.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Elbow moving away from the body.
Twisting the torso instead of rotating the arm.
band-external-rotation.safety: Use a light band. This is a gentle exercise: no pain, no jerks.

barbell-curl.name: Barbell curl
barbell-curl.desc: Curling a barbell from the thighs to the shoulders while standing. Works the biceps.
cues: Grip shoulder-width, palms forward.
Elbows stay at the sides.
Curl up, lower slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Swinging the torso.
Elbows drifting forward.
Half reps at the bottom.
barbell-curl.safety: Put collars on the bar if you use plates. Reduce the weight if you need to swing.

db-curl.name: Dumbbell curl
db-curl.desc: Curling dumbbells while standing, both arms or alternating. Works the biceps.
cues: Elbows at the sides, palms forward.
Curl up while turning the palm slightly up.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Swinging the dumbbells.
Lifting the elbows forward.
db-curl.safety: Choose a weight you can lift without leaning back.

cable-curl.name: Cable curl
cable-curl.desc: Curling a low cable handle. Steady tension for the biceps.
cues: Stand close to the cable, elbows at the sides.
Curl the handle to the shoulders.
Lower slowly without letting the stack touch.
mistakes: Leaning back.
Elbows moving forward.
cable-curl.safety: Hold the handle until the weight stack is down.

concentration-curl.name: Concentration curl
concentration-curl.desc: Seated one-arm curl with the elbow against the inner thigh. Strict work for the biceps.
cues: Sit on a bench, elbow against the inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up toward the shoulder.
Lower all the way down slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the elbow off the thigh.
Helping with the shoulder.
concentration-curl.safety: Use a moderate weight: the point is control.

reverse-curl.name: Reverse curl
reverse-curl.desc: Curling a bar with the palms facing down. Works the forearms and biceps.
cues: Overhand grip, shoulder-width.
Elbows at the sides, curl up.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Wrists bending back.
Swinging the body.
reverse-curl.safety: Use a lighter weight than for a regular curl.

skull-crusher.name: Lying triceps extension (skull crusher)
skull-crusher.desc: Lowering a bar toward the forehead and straightening the arms, lying on a bench. Works the triceps.
cues: Upper arms vertical or slightly angled toward the head.
Bend only at the elbows, lower the bar toward the forehead.
Straighten the arms without moving the shoulders.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out.
Upper arms moving back and forth.
Dropping the bar fast.
skull-crusher.safety: Lower the bar slowly and never let it fall toward the face. Start light; ask for a spotter when you go heavier.

close-grip-bench-press.name: Close-grip bench press
close-grip-bench-press.desc: Bench press with the hands about shoulder-width. Puts more work on the triceps.
cues: Grip about shoulder-width, not narrower.
Elbows close to the body on the way down.
Touch the lower chest and press up.
Shoulder blades back, feet on the floor.
mistakes: Grip so narrow the wrists hurt.
Elbows flaring out.
Bouncing the bar off the chest.
close-grip-bench-press.safety: Use a rack with safety arms or a spotter and put collars on the bar. Skip the set if you can't control the movement.

bench-dip.name: Bench dip
bench-dip.desc: Lowering and pushing up with the hands on a bench behind you. Works the triceps.
cues: Hands on the bench edge, fingers forward.
Lower until the elbows are about 90°, back close to the bench.
Push up until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Going too deep and straining the shoulders.
Elbows flaring out.
bench-dip.safety: Bend the knees to make it easier. Stop at any pain in the front of the shoulder.

overhead-db-extension.name: Overhead dumbbell extension
overhead-db-extension.desc: Lowering one dumbbell behind the head with both hands and straightening the arms. Works the long head of the triceps.
cues: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower it behind the head, elbows pointing up.
Straighten the arms.
mistakes: Elbows flaring wide.
Arching the lower back.
overhead-db-extension.safety: Hold the dumbbell securely by the plate. Sit on a bench with a back support if you want more stability.

triceps-kickback.name: Triceps kickback
triceps-kickback.desc: Straightening the arm backward with a dumbbell, bent over with support on a bench. Works the triceps.
cues: Upper arm along the body, parallel to the floor.
Straighten the arm back, only the forearm moves.
Bend back slowly.
mistakes: Upper arm dropping down.
Swinging the dumbbell.
triceps-kickback.safety: Use a light dumbbell and keep the supporting arm straight.

plank.name: Plank
plank.desc: Holding a straight body on the forearms and toes. Trains the core to keep the trunk stable.
cues: Elbows under the shoulders, forearms on the floor.
Body in one line from head to heels, glutes tight.
Breathe calmly and hold for the planned time.
mistakes: Hips sagging toward the floor.
Hips pushed high up.
plank.safety: Start on the knees if a full plank is too hard. Stop if the lower back hurts.

hanging-leg-raise.name: Hanging leg raise
hanging-leg-raise.desc: Raising straight legs while hanging from a bar. A hard exercise for the abs.
cues: Hang with the shoulders active, not relaxed.
Raise the legs in front of you by tilting the pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Swinging the whole body.
Lifting the legs only with the hip flexors, the pelvis stays still.
hanging-leg-raise.safety: Learn the hanging knee raise first. Step down onto a box, don't drop from the bar.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.desc: Lifting the shoulders off the floor while lying on the back. Works the abs.
cues: Knees bent, feet on the floor.
Curl the shoulder blades off the floor, lower back stays down.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Pulling the head with the hands.
Sitting up all the way with momentum.
crunch.safety: Keep the neck relaxed; lightly support the head with the fingertips if needed.

reverse-crunch.name: Reverse crunch
reverse-crunch.desc: Curling the pelvis up toward the chest while lying on the back. Works the lower part of the abs.
cues: Start with the knees bent at 90° over the hips.
Curl the pelvis up off the floor using the abs.
Lower slowly to the start.
mistakes: Swinging the legs to get up.
Dropping the pelvis fast.
reverse-crunch.safety: Lie on a mat and hold the edge of a bench behind you if you need support.

russian-twist.name: Russian twist
russian-twist.desc: Turning the torso from side to side while sitting leaning back. Works the obliques.
cues: Sit leaning back, back straight, heels on the floor.
Turn the shoulders and hands to one side, then the other.
Move slowly, the pelvis stays still.
mistakes: Moving only the arms, not the torso.
Rounding the back.
russian-twist.safety: Keep the heels on the floor until you are comfortable. Use light weight or none.

bird-dog.name: Bird dog
bird-dog.desc: Reaching one arm forward and the opposite leg back on all fours. Trains stability of the trunk.
cues: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips.
Reach one arm and the opposite leg out to a straight line.
Pause, return and switch sides.
mistakes: Hips tilting to the side.
Arching the lower back to lift the leg higher.
bird-dog.safety: Use a mat under the knees. Move slowly, balance matters more than height.

bicycle-crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
bicycle-crunch.desc: Bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee in turn while lying on the back. Works the abs and obliques.
cues: Shoulders off the floor, hands lightly at the head.
Bring one knee in and turn the opposite shoulder toward it, the other leg straightens.
Switch sides at a steady pace.
mistakes: Pulling the head forward with the hands.
Rushing and only moving the elbows.
bicycle-crunch.safety: Keep the lower back against the floor; raise the straight leg higher if it arches.

hollow-hold.name: Hollow hold
hollow-hold.desc: Holding the shoulders and legs off the floor with the lower back pressed down. Static work for the abs.
cues: Press the lower back into the floor.
Lift the shoulders and the legs a little off the floor.
Hold the position and breathe.
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.
Holding the breath.
hollow-hold.safety: Bend the knees or raise the legs higher to make it easier.

cable-woodchop.name: Cable woodchop
cable-woodchop.desc: Pulling a cable handle diagonally across the body from high to low. Works the obliques and trains rotation control.
cues: Stand side-on to the cable, feet wider than the hips.
Pull the handle diagonally down across the body with straight arms.
Turn the torso and the back foot, return slowly.
mistakes: Pulling only with the arms.
Twisting the lower back without the hips moving.
cable-woodchop.safety: Choose a weight you can turn smoothly without jerks.

kettlebell-swing.name: Kettlebell swing
kettlebell-swing.desc: Swinging a kettlebell to chest height by driving the hips forward. Works the glutes and the back of the legs.
cues: Hinge at the hips, back flat, kettlebell between the legs.
Drive the hips forward sharply; the arms only guide the bell.
Let it swing to chest height and fall back into the hinge.
Stand tall at the top, glutes tight.
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging.
Lifting the bell with the arms.
Rounding the back at the bottom.
kettlebell-swing.safety: Start with a light kettlebell and learn the hip hinge first. Keep a clear space in front and behind, and grip the handle firmly.

kettlebell-push-press.name: Kettlebell push press
kettlebell-push-press.desc: Pressing a kettlebell overhead from the shoulder with a short knee dip. Works the shoulders and triceps.
cues: Bell resting on the forearm at the shoulder.
Short dip of the knees, then drive up and press.
Lower the bell to the shoulder under control.
mistakes: Deep squat instead of a short dip.
Leaning back under the bell.
kettlebell-push-press.safety: Use a light kettlebell and a clear space overhead. Skip the set if you can't control the bell.

burpee.name: Burpee
burpee.desc: Moving from standing to a push-up position and back with a jump. Works the whole body.
cues: Squat, put the hands on the floor, step or jump back to a plank.
Bring the feet back under you.
Stand up and jump lightly with the arms overhead.
mistakes: Hips sagging in the plank.
Landing hard on stiff legs.
burpee.safety: Step back and forth instead of jumping if you need an easier version.

jump-rope.name: Jump rope
jump-rope.desc: Jumping over a turning rope. Trains the calves, coordination and endurance.
cues: Elbows close to the body, turn the rope with the wrists.
Small, light jumps on the balls of the feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Jumping too high.
Turning the rope with the whole arms.
jump-rope.safety: Jump on a flat, non-slip surface. Adjust the rope length to your height.

rowing-machine.name: Rowing machine
rowing-machine.desc: Rowing strokes on a machine: legs, then torso, then arms. Works the whole body.
cues: Push with the legs first, then lean back slightly, then pull the handle to the ribs.
Return in reverse: arms, torso, legs.
Keep the back straight throughout.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms before the legs.
Rounding the back at the catch.
rowing-machine.safety: Fasten the foot straps. Start at an easy pace.

treadmill-walk.name: Brisk treadmill walk
treadmill-walk.desc: Walking at a brisk pace on a treadmill. A steady movement for the legs and endurance.
cues: Walk upright, arms swinging naturally.
Land on the heel and roll through the foot.
Choose a pace where you can still talk.
mistakes: Holding on to the handrails all the time.
Very long steps.
treadmill-walk.safety: Clip on the safety key and start at a low speed.

stationary-bike.name: Stationary bike
stationary-bike.desc: Pedalling on an exercise bike. A steady movement for the legs and endurance.
cues: Seat height: the knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal smoothly in circles.
Keep the shoulders relaxed.
mistakes: Seat too low.
Rocking the hips on the seat.
stationary-bike.safety: Adjust the seat and handlebar before you start.

farmer-carry.name: Farmer's carry
farmer-carry.desc: Walking with heavy dumbbells or kettlebells in the hands. Trains grip, the core and posture.
cues: Stand tall, shoulders down and back.
Short, even steps.
Put the weights down with a straight back.
mistakes: Leaning to one side.
Shrugging the shoulders.
farmer-carry.safety: Plan a clear route. Lift and lower the weights like a deadlift, not with a round back.

mountain-climber.name: Mountain climber
mountain-climber.desc: Driving the knees to the chest in turn from a push-up position. Works the core and raises the heart rate.
cues: Hands under the shoulders, body straight.
Drive one knee toward the chest, then switch.
Keep the hips level.
mistakes: Hips going high.
Bouncing the hips up and down.
mountain-climber.safety: Slow down or step instead of jumping if the wrists or shoulders complain.

jumping-jack.name: Jumping jack
jumping-jack.desc: Jumping the feet apart while raising the arms, then back together. A simple warm-up movement.
cues: Land softly on the balls of the feet.
Arms go up as the feet go apart.
Keep a steady rhythm.
mistakes: Landing on stiff legs.
Arms only half-way up.
jumping-jack.safety: Step to the side instead of jumping for a gentler version.

cat-cow.name: Cat-cow
cat-cow.desc: Rounding and arching the back on all fours. Mobility for the spine.
cues: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips.
Round the back up, chin toward the chest.
Then gently arch, chest forward, gaze ahead.
mistakes: Moving only the neck.
Rushing the movement.
cat-cow.safety: Move in a comfortable range, without pain.

hip-flexor-stretch.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
hip-flexor-stretch.desc: Shifting the hips forward in a half kneel. Stretches the front of the hip.
cues: Half kneel, knee of the back leg on a mat.
Tuck the pelvis slightly and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift the hips forward until you feel the stretch.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of moving the hips.
Front knee going far past the toes.
hip-flexor-stretch.safety: Put a mat or a folded towel under the knee.

hamstring-stretch.name: Seated hamstring stretch
hamstring-stretch.desc: Leaning forward to the toes, sitting with straight legs. Stretches the back of the thighs.
cues: Sit with the legs straight, toes up.
Lean forward from the hips with a long back.
Stop at a comfortable stretch and breathe.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach further.
Bouncing.
hamstring-stretch.safety: Bend the knees slightly if the stretch is too strong.

thoracic-rotation.name: Quadruped thoracic rotation
thoracic-rotation.desc: Rotating the upper back on all fours with one hand behind the head. Mobility for the upper back.
cues: On all fours, one hand behind the head.
Turn the elbow down toward the other arm.
Then rotate it up toward the ceiling, following it with the eyes.
mistakes: Moving the hips instead of the upper back.
Rushing.
thoracic-rotation.safety: Move slowly and stay in a comfortable range.

band-pull-apart.name: Band pull-apart
band-pull-apart.desc: Stretching a band across the chest with straight arms. Warm-up for the upper back and the back of the shoulders.
cues: Arms straight in front at shoulder height.
Pull the band apart until it touches the chest.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders.
Bending the elbows a lot.
band-pull-apart.safety: Check the band for tears and hold it firmly so it can't snap toward the face.

childs-pose.name: Child's pose
childs-pose.desc: Sitting back on the heels with the arms reaching forward on the floor. A gentle stretch for the back and hips.
cues: Knees on the mat, sit back toward the heels.
Reach the arms forward, forehead toward the floor.
Breathe slowly into the back.
mistakes: Forcing the hips down to the heels.
Holding the breath.
childs-pose.safety: Put a pillow under the hips or the knees if the position is uncomfortable.

doorway-chest-stretch.name: Doorway chest stretch
doorway-chest-stretch.desc: Leaning forward with the forearm on a door frame. Stretches the chest and the front of the shoulder.
cues: Forearm on the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step forward until you feel the stretch across the chest.
Hold and breathe, then switch sides.
mistakes: Elbow higher than the shoulder.
Pushing into pain.
doorway-chest-stretch.safety: The stretch should feel gentle. Stop at any tingling in the arm.

calf-stretch.name: Wall calf stretch
calf-stretch.desc: Leaning on a wall with one leg back. Stretches the calf.
cues: Hands on the wall, one leg back.
Back heel on the floor, back knee straight.
Lean forward until you feel the stretch.
mistakes: Back heel lifting.
Back foot turned out.
calf-stretch.safety: Wear shoes with grip or stand barefoot on a non-slip floor.

arm-circles.name: Arm circles
arm-circles.desc: Circling straight arms forward and back. A warm-up for the shoulders.
cues: Arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Start with small circles, make them gradually bigger.
Change direction halfway.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders.
Swinging fast from the start.
arm-circles.safety: Stay in a range that feels comfortable for the shoulders.

figure-four-stretch.name: Figure-four glute stretch
figure-four-stretch.desc: Leaning forward with one ankle on the opposite knee, seated. Stretches the glute.
cues: Sit on a bench, ankle on the opposite knee.
Lean forward with a long back.
Hold where you feel the stretch in the glute.
mistakes: Rounding the back.
Pushing the knee down hard.
figure-four-stretch.safety: Keep the foot of the crossed leg flexed to protect the knee.

quad-stretch.name: Standing quad stretch
quad-stretch.desc: Pulling the heel toward the glute while standing on one leg. Stretches the front of the thigh.
cues: Hold a wall with one hand.
Hold the ankle and bring the heel toward the glute.
Knees together, pelvis slightly tucked.
mistakes: Arching the lower back.
Knee drifting out to the side.
quad-stretch.safety: Hold on for balance. Don't pull hard on the knee.

leg-swing.name: Leg swings
leg-swing.desc: Swinging a straight leg forward and back while holding a support. Warm-up for the hips.
cues: Stand side-on to a wall, hold it with one hand.
Swing the leg forward and back in a comfortable range.
Torso upright, make the swings gradually bigger.
mistakes: Leaning the torso to swing higher.
Kicking hard from the start.
leg-swing.safety: Keep a clear space around the leg.
